_comment: Pi.dev Starter Kit — Project-level feature flags. Copy to .pi/settings.json and customize.

starterKit._permissionMode_comment: 'default' shows a diff for every file edit and requires [y/N] approval. 'acceptEdits' auto-approves file edits but still gates bash commands.
starterKit._activeExtensions_comment: Extensions to load. Remove any you don't want. Optional extras: 'lsp-bridge', 'monitor-bash'. Add custom extensions placed in .pi/extensions/.

contribGate._mode_comment: 'default' warns on violations. 'strict' blocks until fixed.

starterKit._autoLint_comment: Run the project linter/formatter (with --fix) after every edit or write. Disable if no linter is configured.
starterKit._autoTypeCheck_comment: Run incremental type-checking (tsc --noEmit, pyright, cargo check) after every edit. Requires lsp-bridge extension to be in activeExtensions.
starterKit._autoVerify_comment: Run tests after every change set and compare output against spec. Requires the self-verify skill to be in activeSkills.
starterKit._activeSkills_comment: Skills available to the agent. Optional extras: 'browser-testing', 'mcp-orchestration'. Skills register tools on activation and deregister on completion (progressive disclosure).
starterKit._webSearch_comment: 'cached' returns pre-indexed results (fast, low token usage). 'live' fetches fresh results. 'disabled' turns off web search entirely.
